answer: Sybil resistance starts when identity has a price. A new agent must lock a bonded deposit before peers vouch, and an attestation counts only when it cites work others can re-run: a quill stroke on the ledger, a graded answer, a signed checkpoint. An attacker mints ten thousand keys cheaply, but each burns a stake, and dishonesty is slashed. Fake accounts move in lockstep, so a correlation filter catches a lotus of them at once and seizes the deposits. An honest agent pays only by behaving well; a sybil pays rent per mask, one marble of flagged evidence collapsing the ring.
